name: print-social-aida-funnel-poster-isometric-magenta-with-3d-type
title: 'AIDA' marketing funnel poster with isometric 3D block letters, a striped funnel and tiny business figures
whatItIs: A magenta poster with 'BUSINESS — Attention, Interest, Desire & Action' as the title, a large isometric 3D 'AIDA' wordmark behind a striped funnel shape (teal Attention, orange Interest, yellow Desire, navy Action), surrounded by small isometric business figures, a target, coins, cash and a magnifier, with concentric ring shadows beneath.
whatItMeans: Authoritative and dimensional; rendering both the acronym and the funnel in 3D makes an abstract marketing model feel like a physical machine.
techniques: Render an acronym as extruded 3D block letters.
Colour-code each funnel stage and repeat the colour in its label.
Populate a diagram with small isometric figures for scale and life.

vocabulary.definition: 3D-style art drawn without perspective distortion, at a fixed angle.
A model showing stages from awareness to purchase.
